selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent sysctl file was installed and applied. Before and after reboot, all/default/ens2/lo reported accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID a30092e0-dc8d-48de-a1bc-cf71940b0044; systemd-sysctl and SSH were active, hardened values persisted, ens2 was up, and the default route recovered.

commands.command:
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release && printf '%s %s
' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; printf 'LIVE_SYSCTLS
'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf 'NETWORK_HEALTH
'; ip -4 -brief addr show up; ip -4 route show; printf 'PERSISTENT_REFERENCES
'; grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true

printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'PERSISTENT_CONFIG
'; sudo cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf; printf 'ALL_LIVE_IPV4_INTERFACE_CONTROLS
'; failed=0; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; r=$(cat "$d/accept_redirects"); s=$(cat "$d/accept_source_route"); printf '%s accept_redirects=%s accept_source_route=%s
' "$n" "$r" "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] && [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || failed=1; done; printf 'NETWORK_HEALTH
'; ip -4 -brief addr show up; ip -4 route show; exit "$failed"
